svg.data-weight: 5.51 kg (12.15 lb) with the power supply and fan modules, 6315 g in Table 8 (Table 19)
svg.data-depth-with-modules: 382.4 mm (15.05 in., 38.24 cm) with the power supply and fan modules installed (Tables 8 and 19)
svg.data-width-with-brackets: 482 mm (19 in.) with the mounting brackets attached (rack requirements)
svg.data-poe-budget-w: 740 W with one supply, 1440 W with two (Table 32)
svg.data-poe-standard: PoE+ on all 24 ports, 30 W per port by default (Table 8)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 through 127 VAC or 200 through 240 VAC, 50 or 60 Hz (Table 30)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 45 C (32 to 113 F), 40 C with 10GBASE-T transceivers (environmental requirements)
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 1524 m (5,000 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 EX4100 switches. The four SFP28 ports are dedicated Virtual Chassis ports
svg.data-uplink-ports: four SFP+ ports take 1 GbE or 10 GbE transceivers, with MACsec
svg.data-macsec: the SFP+ uplink ports are MACsec-enabled
svg.data-optics-sfp28: the four Virtual Chassis ports are 10GE or 25GE SFP28 ports (Table 8). VC formation is not supported with a 10GBASE-T transceiver in them
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the four uplink ports are 1GE or 10GE SFP+ ports (Table 8). With a 10GBASE-T transceiver the maximum ambient is 40 C
svg.data-oob: management Ethernet RJ-45 on the rear panel, with a link activity lamp and a status lamp
svg.data-console: RJ-45 console on the rear panel and RS232 to USB Type-C console on the front, both labelled CON
svg.data-usb: one USB 2.0 Type-A port on the rear panel
svg.data-acoustic: 39.4 dB typical and 49.4 dB maximum with one supply, 40.0 and 50.1 with two (Table 4)

g.title: led-alm

g.data-description: Table 22 - standalone: green steady is normal, unlit is powered off or halted. Virtual Chassis: green steady primary, green blinking backup, unlit linecard member
